name: schedule_list
description: List persisted Host-level scheduled tasks. Every session can see the Host board; active tasks are ordered by next occurrence, paused and ended tasks by recent update.

active.description: true lists only active tasks, false only paused/ended tasks; omit to list all.

offset.description: Number of filtered tasks to skip; default 0.

prompt: Host-level scheduled tasks: create, list, view, and edit a persisted rule that delivers a synthetic user follow-up at its due time. `{{tools}}` manage the rule only; the delivered turn does the work. A schedule is not a Job: use `job_*`/`workflow` when you need immediate asynchronous execution, output and cancellation.
